description:
Manage spells: shelve, unshelve, move, delete, repair, repair all, or rollback to a previous seal.

Use when: When you need to reorganize, archive, restore, move, remove, fix, or revert spells.
Not for: When creating new spells — use inscribe_spell. When sealing changes — use hone_spell.

inputSchema.description: Manage a spell. Use action to select the operation.

action.description: The management action to perform: shelve, unshelve, move, delete, repair, repair_all, or rollback.

force.description: Replace an existing spell at the same path. Default false.

path.description: Spell path — required for all actions except repair_all.

ref.description: Git commit hash to revert to — required for rollback. Use inspect_grimoire_item to find seal hashes from history.

verbose.description: Include the full spell when available.

name: manage_spell
